object.name: SharedWidgetQuery
object.description: This object represents an incoming query from a forwarded message with a shared widget created by the bot. Use answerWidgetQuery to answer the query. Each user can send at most 5 queries per 5 seconds to the bot from all its widgets.
object.html_description: This object represents an incoming query from a forwarded message with a shared widget created by the bot. Use answerWidgetQuery to answer the query. Each user can send at most 5 queries per 5 seconds to the bot from all its widgets.
object.rst_description: This object represents an incoming query from a forwarded message with a shared widget created by the bot. Use :class:`aiogram.methods.answer_widget_query.AnswerWidgetQuery` to answer the query. Each user can send at most 5 queries per 5 seconds to the bot from all its widgets.
